<!-- pr-reviewer: 849ff88c5823311ca3321d105a4627f132eee2c5 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Test-only, 7 added lines in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/theme_door.rs:59` and a doc note on `SNAPSHOT_LOCK` (`tests.rs:1739`).
- The guard is the same `snapshot_guard()` / `SNAPSHOT_LOCK` the structural tests (`structural.rs:142,156,182`) and snapshot tests (`tests.rs:1727,1757,1861`) take, so they now serialise with the theme-door switch test.
- The only production writer of the live table is `theme::set_current`, reached solely via `State::sync_theme` (`state.rs:3573`). I found no other test that switches the world's theme without the lock; the remaining `Tokens::LIGHT/DARK` uses only read constants.
- No snapshot PNG, golden, dependency, build.rs or .github changes; no CHANGELOG edit; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #605`.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, clean merge)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` | 376 passed, 1 failed (`headless_run_succeeds`, "No suitable graphics adapter" - known environmental), 5 ignored |
| `structural theme_door` x20 parallel | 0/20 failures |
| `egui_app::tests::` x20 parallel | 0 structural/theme failures (only the known headless_run_succeeds each run) |
| clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking):** the lock is a convention; a future test that moves the world's theme must remember to take it (the new doc comment says so).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
